name: graphlet
description: Draws graphs of nodes and links inside Claude Code: in Claude's replies, and for other mods to build on

scroll.title: Scrolling
scroll.description: How a graph wider than its room scrolls: pinned keeps the layers that fit in view and slides the long ones together; sheet lays every layer on one wide sheet and moves it whole.

labels.title: Long labels
labels.description: What becomes of a label too long for one line of its box: wrap breaks it onto more lines; clip keeps it to one line, cut in the middle.

links.title: Links
links.description: How the links between two layers share the rows there: separate gives each box's links a row of their own wherever they would run into another's; merged runs those of one kind along one row, which is shorter.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Whether the selected node's links move: still lights them as lines; flowing runs beads along each link that runs one way, toward the node it reaches, and pulses the links that run no way or both ways.

replies.title: Graphs in replies
replies.description: Whether Claude draws graphs in its replies: on tells Claude it can, in a few lines of the system prompt, and draws each graph it writes; off adds nothing to the system prompt and leaves replies as Claude writes them, for graphlet as a library for other mods alone.
